quotes.text: The content on this page is deprecated and is superseded by:
This doc refers to a *Legacy* (Technology that's no longer recommended) feature that’s no longer available in the latest version of Stripe.js.
Use the `isEligible` or `isCartEligible` options to indicate that the current product or cart isn’t eligible.

findings: Both full captures say legacy afterpayClearpayMessage is no longer available in the latest Stripe.js and recommend the separate Payment Method Messaging Element. The new capture elevates that existing state into a [Deprecated] title, banner and supersession link; it does not newly remove the feature. The source already warns clearly and routes to the successor (old raw lines 4-14; new raw lines 5-21; source lines 2, 11-17).

The legacy web HTML/JS path loads a Clover Stripe.js script, creates stripe.elements(), uses a publishable key and amount/currency options, and mounts afterpayClearpayMessage; the React path uses Elements with AfterpayClearpayMessageElement. These remain historical examples for the legacy web Element, not current availability evidence or client payment-confirmation code. No PaymentIntent, Checkout Session, charge or payment success is established by mounting a message (old raw lines 16-89; new raw lines 23-89; source lines 13, 17).

Logo, CSS, ineligible-item options and country price-range messaging are unchanged; the legacy locale list is en-US/en-CA/en-AU/en-NZ/en-GB with USD/CAD/AUD/NZD/GBP currencies. The element's display or ineligible message is promotional messaging, not a guarantee that a customer is eligible, an offer is approved, or a payment completed (old raw lines 91-135; new raw lines 91-135; source lines 19-23).

The new linked prohibited-category and payment-options fragment anchors replace older anchors, and JS/JSX quotes/spacing change, without changing described behavior. The current source's legacy/deprecation and successor distinction is accurate against both captures (old raw lines 8, 111-127; new raw lines 9-15, 111-127; source lines 11-23).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the 2026-05-06 Clover/React legacy implementation and customization details dated, since both captures still display them as examples under explicit deprecation, not as recommendations for latest Stripe.js (old raw lines 8, 16-135; new raw lines 13-135).

Keep the successor Payment Method Messaging Element as a separate component and source route; do not transfer legacy afterpayClearpayMessage option names or locale behavior to it without reading its own authority (old raw line 8; new raw lines 9-15; wiki/concepts/stripe-payment-method-messaging-element.md lines 8-36).
unresolved_questions: Neither capture identifies the exact last Stripe.js version with legacy afterpayClearpayMessage, and the Clover script in a deprecated example does not prove it works in current hosted Stripe.js (old raw lines 8, 22-54; new raw lines 13-15, 29-59).

Current customer/merchant BNPL eligibility and successor Element option parity require separate authority; display examples here cannot establish checkout enablement, credit approval, or payment outcome (new raw lines 9-21, 111-135).

findings: The source already labels the legacy Element deprecated, warns it is unavailable in latest Stripe.js, links the successor, and accurately summarizes locale, eligibility display and customization (source lines 1-27; old raw lines 8-135; new raw lines 9-135).

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/afterpay-clearpay/site-messaging, the complete new capture identifies afterpayClearpayMessage as a deprecated legacy web Stripe.js Element, unavailable in the latest version, and points to the separate Payment Method Messaging Element as successor (new raw lines 5-21). Its historical HTML/JS and React examples mount promotional messaging with publishable-key Stripe.js/Elements, amount and currency; eligibility-display options and locale/currency lists are given, but no Checkout Session, PaymentIntent, charge or payment outcome is created by this display step (new raw lines 23-135). The paired old capture already made the same legacy/latest-version warning and had the same functional examples (old raw lines 8-135). source-stripe-afterpay-clearpay-messaging.md accurately marks that boundary and summarizes the dated behavior (source lines 11-27).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/afterpay-clearpay/site-messaging, the new [Deprecated] title, supersession callout, changed link fragments and reformatted JS/JSX examples are presentational or navigational: the old capture already said the legacy Element was unavailable in latest Stripe.js and recommended the successor (old raw lines 4-14, 34-89, 111-127; new raw lines 5-21, 41-89, 111-127). No substantive reversal requires replacing source-stripe-afterpay-clearpay-messaging.md, whose warning is already accurate. Preserve its older Clover/React examples as dated legacy evidence, not current latest-version instructions; the successor Element has its own API and eligibility scope. Displaying ineligible range messaging, a modal or a localized installment amount neither establishes customer credit approval, merchant enablement nor a completed payment.
